description: This Java class 'LogWrapper' implements the 'LogNode' interface and provides a wrapper around Android's native Log utility. It forwards logging calls and can chain to additional LogNode instances, facilitating flexible and extendable logging behavior within an Android application.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps around Android's Log utility, implementing LogNode, allowing logs to be forwarded and chained.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified priority, tag, and optional throwable. It forwards the log to Android's Log and passes it along the chain if applicable.
